Excluding these items, operating income decreased in fiscal 2019 due primarily to lower volume.

## Liquidity and Capital Resources

Our ability to fund our future capital needs will be affected by our ability to continue to generate cash from operations and may be affected by our ability to access the capital markets, money markets, or other sources of funding, as well as the capacity and terms of our financing arrangements. We believe that cash generated from operations and, to the extent necessary, these other sources of potential funding will be sufficient to meet our anticipated capital needs for the foreseeable future, including the payment of $350 million of floating rate senior notes due in fiscal 2020, the pending acquisition of First Sensor, and cash spending related to restructuring initiatives. We may use excess cash to purchase a pono oo suss s unn ou uod os ur pnn s ou und sus oo sn n o lines, to pay dividends on our common shares, or to reduce our outstanding debt. The cost or availability of future funding may be impacted by financial market conditions. We will continue to monitor financial markets and respond as necessary to changing conditions.
